9601: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly bend the knee and lower the other heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through the standing leg to rise.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
9602: Stand on the edge of a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Push up through the standing leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
9603: Stand with one foot on a low step.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Drive back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
9604: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
9605: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot slowly toward the floor.
Keep your knee stable and your torso tall.
Rise back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
9606: Stand on the edge of a low box with feet hip-width apart.
Step off, do not jump, and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing by bending your knees and hips.
Immediately explode upward into a jump.
9607: Set a bar in a rack at mid-thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Stand with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Brace your core and chest up.
Pull up on the bar as hard as you can without it moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, then release gradually.
9608: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.
9609: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with a flat back.
Brace your core and push the floor away.
Stand fully tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bell back to the floor with control.
9610: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the plate steady.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.
9611: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.
9612: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box.
Step one foot up onto the box.
Press through it and bring your other foot up.
Step down to the far side one foot at a time.
9653: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to one side, letting your arms swing around.
Let your back heel lift slightly if needed.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Continue at an easy rhythm for 30 seconds.
9676: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Grip the handles and keep your hips down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly back to the start.
9677: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Jump both feet a short way to one side.
Jump them back through the centre to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 20-30 seconds.
9679: Stand tall with one hand held out in front at waist height.
Hop on one leg while driving the opposite knee up to tap your hand.
Land softly and quickly switch legs.
Continue at a lively pace for 20-30 seconds.
9690: Place your heels on small plates and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows up.
Sit down into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
9691: Place your heels on a low plate or wedge.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down into a deep squat with your chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press up to stand and repeat.
9692: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Press the other arm on the next rep.
9693: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
9694: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a barbell at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
9695: Kneel on one knee and hold the end of the landmine at your shoulder.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
9696: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and a bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
9697: Clean a kettlebell so it is upside down with the bell above your fist.
Press it overhead with a firm wrist.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Walk slowly in a straight line.
Lower it safely and switch arms.
9698: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
9699: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
